description: Get a studio's profile (name, whether it's an animation studio) and the titles it's credited on (`media`, most popular first), by AniList studio ID or by name. `media` is paginated (`page`/`perPage`, max 25) — check `media.pageInfo.hasNextPage` before treating it as the studio's full catalog. By default it mixes titles the studio animated with ones it's only credited on (e.g. as a producer); set `isMain` to split them. Confirmed live: `name` already does AniList's own fuzzy search (same mechanism as search_studio), so a partial name (e.g. "Kyoto Anim") resolves directly — reach for search_studio instead only when you need to browse multiple candidates rather than take the closest match. If both `id` and `name` are given, `id` takes precedence and `name` is ignored.

id.description: AniList studio ID. Provide this or `name`.

isMain.description: true: only titles where this was the main animation studio. false: only titles it's credited on without being the main studio (e.g. as a producer). Omit for both. Confirmed live: Aniplex has 1 main-studio title but many more producer credits.

name.description: Studio name to look up. Provide this or `id`.

onList.description: [Requires login] Restrict the filmography to (true) or exclude (false) titles already on the authenticated user's own list. Omit to ignore list status entirely. Errors if not logged in (AniList would otherwise silently ignore it and return the unfiltered filmography).

page.description: Page number for pagination. AniList's paginated connections (search results, a title's characters/staff/reviews, activity feeds, forum comments) reject a page whose page × perPage exceeds ~5000 entries with an upstream error, so paging that deep fails rather than returning more results.

perPage.description: Results per page (max 25, AniList's own ceiling — it silently clamps anything higher).

name: get_studio

isFavourite.description: [Requires login] Whether this studio is in the caller's favourites. Has a brief read-after-write lag on AniList's own backend — confirmed live, a re-check right after toggle_favourite can briefly still show the pre-toggle value.

lastPage.description: Not currently accurate (a known AniList performance limitation) — use `hasNextPage` instead to decide whether to fetch another page.

total.description: Not currently accurate (a known AniList performance limitation) — don't rely on it to decide whether to fetch more pages.

title: Get studio
